objective_preserved: REA launcher -> independent launcher -> REA game -> playable independent game across web/mobile-web/WeChat

format.payload: original owned file bytes in row order;1024files,32MiB/file,64MiB total
format.integrity: MD5(header0..31+metadata) plus existing each-file MD5; non-authenticating corruption detection
format.strictness: exact counts/lengths/revision/reserved fields/canonical JSON, current binding and existing v1/v2 semantics; no trailing bytes
format.schemaPreserved: Existing resources.v1 default/configured source and resources.v2 exact pinned source0/1; no caller-profile field added.

store.algorithm: extract prior catalog two-slot machinery; complete decode/readback, expectedRevision CAS, same-context lock, unknown native write outcome lifetime preserved

host.configuration: optional resourceCacheProfile with patch config; default off, no startup IO
host.operations: explicit check -> matching cached candidate restore -> explicit select -> optional save using checked revision
host.lifecycle: source/selection/catalog change or hide clears preview/revision/owned data; issued write outcome must be rechecked; no automatic IO or retry
host.binding: Existing exact v1/v2 binding; host passes only the explicitly selected resource snapshot, not its separate initialization file input, credentials or session fields. User-local resource contents are never executed by the store.
host.restoredBase: Restored file rows share one page owner as base/candidate; dropping candidate does not clear its still-owned base. Next prepare copies base then runs existing consumer; operation history is not cached or asserted.

validation: independent Python original vectors, full existing file/byte limits, malformed/corrupt/alias/binding/CAS/cancel/late native writes; actual original filesystem+new host/generated Page+Python peer
remaining: Actual native WeChat quota/memory/file semantics/AppID/domain/device and interruption durability
Cross-process/worker writers; corrupt-both-slots remains explicit failure with no automatic deletion or overwrite
Full current launcher/native paths, game consumers/business protocol and authenticated playable game acceptance
